items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: When he did some of his greatest playing with the band, he was 21

ctx.x: As a matter of fact, one of the things I wanted to talk with you a little later on, is dealing with the road, but I'll hold that for a minute or two. Sonny Berman was a young player that we didn't discuss.

Yeah. I think he was truly outstanding for his period in his very short lifetime. When he did some of his greatest playing with the band, he was 21, and I guess he died shortly -- during that same year. So actually, he probably started with us when he was 19 and wound up when he was 21.
Do you recall how he got on, a guy like that?
